pricing_spine.directive: User 2026-07-08: $1/page is dumb. Use $1/week x 52 weeks = $52/year. Months = volume. Years = competent archive.

derived_from: Market comps: Patreon $5 entry / $10-20 premium (Patreon ~10% + ~3% processing); Uncle John's $6-17/book; weekly newsletters $12/mo or $120/yr; zines $1.50-5/issue

tiers.name: The Feed (Free)
tiers.maps_to: Top-of-funnel. Base doc does not price free content.
unlocks: Daily issue (1 real page) — individual searchable posts
Yearly COLLECTION index post (links all daily posts)

tiers.name: Weekly Reader ($1/wk = $52/yr)
tiers.maps_to: THE SPINE: $1/week x 52. ~$5/mo equivalent. Replaces per-page $1.
unlocks: Weekly chronicle volume PDF (52-53/week per year) — the 1-page/day digest bound by week

tiers.name: Monthly Volume ($10/mo = $120/yr)
tiers.maps_to: MONTH = VOLUME (12/yr). Premium 'weird publishing' tier. ~2.3x weekly.
unlocks: Month-as-volume bundle PDF (12/yr) — the month compiled as one volume
30-pages/day MULTIVERSE AU spins (alternate-universe posts) gated per day

tiers.name: Annual Archive ($156/yr)
tiers.maps_to: YEAR = COMPETENT ARCHIVE. 3x weekly. Complete collected works.
unlocks: Full annual multiverse PDF (11k+ pages) — the complete year
Yearly collection index + permanent archive access

individual.description: One Patreon post per daily issue. Searchable via tags. Free tier (public).

weekly_volume.description: One gated post per weekly volume (links/attaches the local week PDF). Gated to Weekly.

monthly_volume.description: One gated post per month-as-volume (links/attaches the month bundle + AU spins). Gated to Monthly Volume.

multiverse_individual.description: One gated post per day's 30 AU spins. Gated to Monthly Volume.

collection_yearly.description: One yearly COLLECTION post indexing all that year's individual posts. Public hub for accessibility.
